Type: table
Name: Phoenix Home Rustic Industrial Solid Wood and Steel Open Shelf Coffee Table, Brown
Colors: Brown
Materials: Pine
Rustic coffee table combines dark hardwood and steel for ultimate strength and a beautiful heirloom-quality aesthetic Planked top and open shelf made of distressed, solid wood with visible natural knots and grain in a warm tone Solid-steel legs with a dark patina and set at a slight angle; X-shaped bracing with exposed metal fasteners and rivets Industrial style mixes materials for edgy, eye-catching results Measures 48 by 24 by 18 inches (LxWxH); 10-inch height between top and open shelf
